lina: FYI qbench on q8b-int4 flagged high dup rate in prompt-gold. looks like quant tokenizer remap caused paraphrase collapse. pinging @labeling-team.
ben: can you show a pair? exact or paraphrase?
lina: example: "Track my package 9876" vs "Where's package 9876?" -> fingerprints match after int4 runtime map.
ravi: our fingerprinting assumes tokenizer v3. runtime v2.9 changed subword boundaries. we should re-fingerprint the affected slice first.
chris: estimate: 250k prompts, targeted slice ~12k. targeted re-fp ~45m, full ~4.5h if parallel.
label-bot: export started: `export_prompts --tag fp_conflict --out s3://redwood/tmp/q8b_conflicts.json` (id: 6612)
lina: i'll open a tiny PR with repro + re-fp script (dry-run flag).
ben: also propose char-rolling fallback for fingerprint on conflict detection. run A/B on 10k.
ravi: agree, A/B needed. label teams may see queue changes; coordinate capacity.
chris: calendar invite created for "q8b-int4 fp rescue" tomorrow 9:00-11:00 PT.
lina: thanks. PR in by EOD, will post results here.
ben: nice, follow-up: sweep int8/fp16 quick check to rule out broader impact.
lina: noted. recap: PR+repro, A/B 10k, labeler capacity, export list. triage tomorrow EOD.
